title: Tailor your résumé
sub: Rewrite for a specific job — verified against your real experience.

applyPrompt.question: Did you apply to this job?

upload.title: 1 · Your résumé
upload.buildLink: No résumé yet? Build one from scratch →

jd.title: 2 · Target job description
jd.hint: Paste the full posting from any job site.

run.keepsRunning: Keeps running if you switch tabs — come back anytime.

langSwitch.he: This job is in Hebrew, so we tailored from your saved Hebrew résumé ({{label}}).
langSwitch.en: This job is in English, so we tailored from your saved English résumé ({{label}}).

toasts.markedApplied: Marked as applied — added to tracker
toasts.trackerError: Could not update the tracker. Is the backend running?
toasts.handoffFailed: Couldn't load the saved job — it may have been deleted.

download.title: Download tailored résumé
download.atsNote: Output is single-column, ATS-safe (no tables, columns, or images).

classic.name: Classic
classic.desc: Navy headings, centered name — the safe default

modern.name: Modern
modern.desc: Teal accent, name at the start, roomier spacing

jdPaste.placeholder: Paste the job description — or drop a job link (LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever…) and fetch it.
jdPaste.noText: Couldn't read the description from that link (the site may require login or block bots). Paste the text instead.

score.title: Match score — before vs. after
score.guardDetail: See the full fabrication check below
score.guardNoteFlags_one: {{count}} claim we couldn't find in your résumé. It doesn't ship until you approve it.
score.guardNoteFlags_other: {{count}} claims we couldn't find in your résumé. They don't ship until you approve them.

report.title: Keyword match report
report.summary: {{missing}} of {{total}} key terms still missing. Only add terms that reflect real experience.
report.clickHint: Click any keyword to see where the job description mentions it. Counts are verbatim mentions: job description × your tailored résumé.
report.notInJdText: Not found word-for-word in the posting — the analysis inferred it.

changelog.cleanBody: Every factual anchor matches your original résumé — nothing invented.
changelog.flagged_one: {{count}} item may not be supported by your résumé.
changelog.flagged_other: {{count}} items may not be supported by your résumé.

review.title: AI edits — accept or reject each
review.note: Rejected edits keep your original wording and are left out of downloads, tracker saves, and the keyword report. The score rings above still show the fully-AI version.
review.resolvedBody: All flagged claims resolved — you rejected every flagged edit.
